## Improvements and fixes

- Fixed fresh installations stopping when FreeSWITCH was already installed during an earlier attempt. The main FS PBX installer now checks the installation and skips the build when it is complete.
- Incomplete FreeSWITCH installations are backed up and rebuilt with fresh defaults. Standalone FreeSWITCH upgrade commands retain their existing behavior.
- Fixed Redis startup on servers without IPv6 loopback support.
- Improved frontend asset handling for Git-managed optional modules and clarified module update warnings and documentation.
- Automated release publication when the application version is increased. Releases become available after their frontend assets have been built, uploaded, and verified.
